label: copy-phase input s or w, late in the copy (recall_idx >= 4)
explanation: Fires almost only in the copy phase (100% of mass), and mostly when the fed-back input is s or w (about 92% of mass; rate about 14x baseline for each). The rate goes up with copy position: low for recall_idx 2-3 and highest for recall_idx 5-8, so it is strongest in long sequences near the end of the copy. Short L=3 sequences are an exception and fire at the final step. It never fires during the original phase or on the delimiter, and never on the first occurrence of a token. Weak, rare activations show up on z, l, n, x and i. Precision is limited: many late copy-phase s/w steps stay below threshold, and nothing about which tokens came before or after cleanly separates them.
